senses.en_definition: To put on or wear clothing, footwear, or accessories.
To use or adopt a tool, language, method, or custom.
(Archaic) To take a woman as a concubine.

collocations.en: take a woman as a concubine
a woman taken as a concubine

senses.en_definition: To use magic, charms, or amulets to protect oneself.

messages.en: Let's wear bright blue tonight. It'll look great in the photos!
I'm not used to wearing bright colours. Is dark blue okay?
Of course. As long as you're comfortable.
I don't want to pressure you. If you're tired, just stay home and rest.
Thanks. I'm really exhausted right now. I'll join you guys next time.
I'd like to share the video of us singing last night in the group chat. Is that okay?
Please don't! I was singing out of tune. It'll just embarrass me.
Why do you keep looking outside? Who are you waiting for?
I'm waiting for my younger brother. He said he's already out front, by the shop entrance.
